objective: Verify that the EGO planner does not interpret unobserved map voxels as free, while preserving the pinned vendor source and control boundary.
interpretation: Static source inspection shows baseline getInflateOccupancy exposed only the inflation byte; unknown cells had zero and were treated free in boolean planner collision checks. Candidate patch maps unknown to blocked. The run still generated splines, but repeated EGO timeout and terminal-in-obstacle logs leave the behavior unqualified. Early EGO sync stalls occurred while adapter MapStatus and odometry outputs continued; a later cluster had last_sync_in_map=false. DDS/executor vs local-map bounds remain unresolved.
qualification: Run-local experiment only; candidate is not in the canonical dependency chain and is not applied to src/vendor. No trajectory execution, PX4, runtime truth, or GOAL C/D/E/F acceptance.
